meta.title: Americano Open
meta.description: Mobile-first platform for tournament signup, approvals, and bracket publishing.

common.demoMode: Demo mode is active. Add `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` to connect the real backend.

home.title: Americano tennis, organized with zero chaos.
home.description: Registration, approval, payment follow-up, player profiles, and published brackets in one clean flow for players and staff.
pitchSteps: Create your account and reserve your place.
Email your payment proof to the tournament inbox.
Get approved by the admin and wait for bracket publication.
home.playersTitle: A clean path from signup to first serve.
home.playersDescription: The public and player-facing experience is designed for phones first, so registration status and published draws are always easy to check.

featureCards.title: Fast signup
featureCards.body: Account creation captures the essentials, then immediately tells the player where to send payment proof.

featureCards.title: Clear approval state
featureCards.body: Every player sees whether payment is pending, confirmed, or approved, without chasing admins over chat.

featureCards.title: Published brackets
featureCards.body: Once the admin finalizes the draw, the live bracket page becomes the source of truth for everyone.

home.publishedTitle: Brackets players can actually read on mobile.
home.publishedDescription: Start with a simple, highly legible bracket list now. We can always evolve this into a richer tree view later.
home.emptyBrackets: No published brackets yet. The admin will publish them once payments and assignments are finalized.

signUp.title: Save your place in the next draw.
signUp.description: Create your account, send payment proof by email, and the admin will approve your entry before bracket publication.
steps: 1. Create your account with your player details.
3. Wait for admin confirmation and watch the bracket publication.
signUp.paymentNotice: After signup, send your payment proof to {paymentEmail}. An admin will confirm it and approve your entry.

errors.usernameFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.
errors.supabase: Supabase is not configured yet. Add the environment variables to enable real signups.

login.title: Track your status and tournament details.
login.description: Players can log in to review approval status, update profile details, and confirm when their bracket has been published.
login.pendingInfo: Pending players can still log in. Your profile page will show whether your payment and tournament approval are still awaiting admin review.
login.profileMissingMessage: Your auth account exists, but the profile row is missing in the database. That usually means the Supabase trigger that creates `profiles` did not run correctly at signup.
login.registeredMessage: Account created. You can log in now and track your approval status from your profile page.

errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.profileMissing: Login succeeded, but your profile row is missing from the database. Check the `handle_new_user` trigger or create the `profiles` row for this user.
errors.supabase: Supabase is not configured yet. Add the environment variables to enable login.

brackets.description: As soon as the admin publishes the latest draw, it appears here for every player and visitor.
brackets.publishHint: Publish when assignments are final and payments are confirmed.

playerProfile.description: Public profile details shown to other players and visitors.
playerProfile.emptyBio: This player has not added a bio yet.

me.description: This page keeps the player informed about payment, approval, and published tournament information.
me.paymentHelp: If your payment is still pending, email the proof to {paymentEmail}. Once the admin confirms it, your approval can move forward and your bracket assignment can be published.

admin.title: Keep approvals and brackets moving.
admin.description: The admin view focuses on the two bottlenecks that matter most in v1: confirming players and publishing the right bracket at the right time.

players.title: Approve players and confirm payments.
players.description: This screen is intentionally desktop-friendly and operational: review player details, confirm payment, and move them into approved status.

brackets.title: Assign players and publish when ready.
brackets.description: V1 keeps bracket management explicit and manual: create a bracket, assign usernames in order, then publish it for everyone.
brackets.createDescription: Enter approved usernames separated by commas in the order you want them assigned.
brackets.publishingDescription: Toggle visibility on the public brackets page. Draft brackets stay admin-only.
brackets.empty: No brackets created yet. Use the form above to create the first one.
